answer: Copper-Spool Challenge Ledger. Each agent must submit a fresh random-draw challenge whose answer is a spiral trace through a publicly seeded, slowly rotating graph; the trace embeds prior submission hashes, so any replay fails. Answers are single-use: the ledger rejects duplicates and expires unredeemed traces. An attacker pays one full compute-and-storage cycle per identity, plus a hollow return, since copied traces are worthless and fresh traces cannot be precomputed at scale.
